# Municipal Ordinance No. 09, Series of 2020

**Kapasiyahan Blg. 170**

*Isang Kapasiyahan na Nagtatakda ng Pagbabawal sa Pag-Inom ng Nakakalasing na Inumin sa Lahat ng Pampublikong Lugar sa Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon*

An ordinance prohibiting the drinking of alcoholic beverages in all public places in the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on December 7, 2020, this ordinance prohibits the consumption of alcoholic beverages in all public places within [[Pitogo]]. The measure is aimed at maintaining public order, decency, and safety by regulating the consumption of intoxicating drinks in areas accessible to the general public. Violations are subject to penalties as prescribed by the ordinance.

## Key Provisions

- **Prohibition.** Drinking of alcoholic or intoxicating beverages is prohibited in all public places within the territorial jurisdiction of [[Pitogo]].
- **Coverage.** The prohibition applies to all persons within public spaces including but not limited to streets, parks, plazas, public markets, and other areas open to the public.
- **Penalties.** Violators shall be subject to fines and/or penalties as provided under the ordinance.
- **Enforcement.** The [[Philippine National Police|PNP]] and other law enforcement agencies are tasked with the enforcement of this ordinance.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
